The Record Store Day Black Friday 2026 drops we actually want

TM

by Tammy Moir

October 7, 2026

  • Music
  • News
  • Copied to clipboard
TM

by Tammy Moir

October 7, 2026

  • Copied to clipboard
    • Music
    • News

    Our favourite day of the year is back, here are the best RSD releases worth getting around.

    Listen to audio version of this article
    Sponsored by
    0:00 / 1:37
    Instaread

    Record Store Day Black Friday is back on November 27, bringing a very large pile of limited-edition records to independent shops around the world.

    We’ve dug through the full 2026 list and pulled out the ones that actually caught our eye, from King Gizzard’s gloriously strange 3D zoetrope to a live Frank Black set, Carissa’s Wierd and Carly Rae Jepsen.

    Here are the RSD Black Friday 2026 drops we’d actually be keeping an eye out for.

    • King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard – Expand Your Mind: Songs in 3D (Deluxe Edition)
    • Florence + The Machine – Everybody Scream (Chamber Version)
    • Stevie Nicks – Bella Donna
    • Holly Humberstone – Live from Cruel World
    • Carly Rae Jepsen – Day and Night (Continued)
    • Masayoshi Takanaka – Super Selection
    • Jeff Tweedy – Twilight in Paris
    • Frank Black – Teenager Of The Year – Live
    • Tom Verlaine – Live NYC 96-06
    • Carissa’s Wierd – You Should Be At Home Here (25th Anniversary Deluxe Edition)
    • Ween – Shinola, Vol. 2
    • Bill Withers – Bill Withers In Concert – Live at the BBC 1974
    • Joji – Piss In The Wind (Deluxe Edition)

    Record Store Day Black Friday lands on Friday November 27, with releases

    available
    through participating independent record stores.

    As ever, quantities vary, so the “I’ll just grab it later” strategy may not work particularly well.

    For us, though, the King Gizzard zoetrope is making a very strong case for getting up early.
